description: Full-scale fork of exp329_cfc (= exp314 arch + CANONICAL_FULL_COVERAGE default). Scales n_steps 25K -> 100K and batch_size 8 -> 32. Tests whether the modernized BitPermutationLUT pipeline (DominanceCanonicalize + SDPA, no Euclidean q/k round-trip) can match or beat exp313 (1.2419, old RankAttention arch) and approach vanilla (1.2031) / exp255 MultiHeadLut (1.2021) at the same scale budget. 210M bit-weights = 25MB bit-packed inference.
